items.name: Melbourne Cubing for Kids Sunday 2023
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbmMvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--563b893d4a4b6b9bb9771fe09170d083965c9e97/logo.png)![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png)
Speedcubing Australia will donate 50% of all registration fees from this competition to the [Exford Primary School] (http://www.exfordps.vic.edu.au/) to assist the children who were injured in the bus rollover accident in May 2023. The funds will contribute their ongoing support and rehabilitation requirements.

**Contact us**
We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!

[Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)

Speedcubing Australia acknowledges the traditional owners of this land, the Wurundjeri people, and pays respect to the elders, past and present for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of Aboriginal Australia.

items.name: Evanston Summer Side Events 2023
items.information:
This competition is in series with [Evanston Summer Big Cubes 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EvanstonSummerBigCubes2023) and [Lisle Summer 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LisleSummer2023). You will only be allowed to compete in one of these three competitions.

Please read all tabs before registering. On the day of the competition, allow at least 15 extra minutes to locate the venue.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://midwestcubing.org).
